cards.name: Bond of Insight
cards.oracleText: Each player mills four cards. Return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Bond of Insight.

cards.name: Bond of Passion
cards.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Bond of Passion deals 2 damage to any other target.

cards.name: Bond of Discipline
cards.oracleText: Tap all creatures your opponents control. Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Bond of Flourishing
cards.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. You gain 3 life.

cards.name: Bond of Revival
cards.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until your next turn.

cards.name: Bond of Agony
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
Each other player loses X life.

cards.name: Manabond
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may reveal your hand and put all land cards from it onto the battlefield. If you do, discard your hand.
